items: Summary: Numbers used to determine how many HP are marked from damage.
When: Use after a hit deals damage.
Not When: Do not mark HP before comparing damage to thresholds.
Question: What happens when I take damage?
Answer: Compare the damage to thresholds, then mark HP by severity.
Example: A 10 damage hit may be Minor, Major, or Severe depending on the PC.
